method: 20 distinct (CVE, CWE) citations from the NVD page read by cwe_measure.py whose CWE id is a weakness in the catalogue (seed 20261128); the start of the CVE description was read against the name of the cited weakness.
note: 19 descriptions describe the cited weakness, several in the same words (CVE-2026-19731 / CWE-22). For CVE-2026-102280 (CWE-390, Detection of Error Condition Without Action) the first 260 characters of the description do not show the error-handling flaw, so it is not counted. Some citations point at a class rather than a specific weakness (CWE-20, CWE-693).
